title: IELTS GT Writing Practice Test 11 — Complaint Letter
instructions: Task 1: Write a letter of at least 150 words. Task 2: Write an essay of at least 250 words.

questions.letterSituation: You live in a block of flats. For the past three weeks, the family living directly above you has been making excessive noise late at night — loud music, heavy footsteps, and parties lasting past midnight — which is seriously affecting your sleep and work performance.
questions.prompt:
You live in a block of flats. For the past three weeks, the family living directly above you has been making excessive noise late at night — loud music, heavy footsteps, and parties lasting past midnight — which is seriously affecting your sleep and work performance.

Write a letter in response to this situation. In your letter:
• describe the problem clearly and explain how long it has been happening
• explain specifically how this situation is affecting your daily life
• say what action you would like the building management to take and by when

Write at least 150 words. You do NOT need to write any addresses.
questions.modelAnswer: A strong response should open with an appropriate greeting, address each bullet point in a separate paragraph with specific detail, maintain the correct register throughout, and close with a suitable sign-off.

questions.prompt: Noise pollution in urban areas has become an increasingly serious problem in recent decades. What are the main causes of this problem and what measures could be introduced to reduce it effectively?
questions.modelAnswer: A strong response should present a clear position supported by well-developed arguments, relevant specific examples, and a logical structure including a focused introduction, detailed body paragraphs, and a concise conclusion.
